recommendation.reason: Agentic Docker benchmark with executable test-case verification; 600 expert-annotated SQL tasks, best model only ~25%, so Real, Solid and Difficult are all strong.
risks: Ground-truth SQL and test cases are released only by email request
Docker database load errors can silently produce abnormally low scores
No repeated runs, error bars or confidence intervals are reported

questions: No public repository or dataset was found in the pool's links, Hugging Face's paper record or the paper's own links. Are the tasks released?
readiness.next_action: Ask the authors where the tasks, environment and grader are released.
